note: The target says 'With Zi numbered as branch 1, Xu occupies position 11 and takes Yang stems' and names 1958's Earth Dog and 2006's Fire Dog as examples. This supports the bridge's position, polarity, and examples.
sentence: That's the mirror image of the [1994 Chinese Zodiac](/1994-chinese-zodiac/) page's Dog year: Xu, the Dog's branch, sits at position 11, an odd-numbered position, so every Dog year on record, 1958's Earth Dog and 2006's Fire Dog included, is Yang.
